node.label: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease axonal type 2N
node.definition: Autosomal dominant Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2N (CMT2N) is a mild form of axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, a peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy, characterized by distal legs sensory loss and weakness that can be asymmetric. Tendon reflexes are reduced in the knees and absent in ankles. Progression is slow.
synonyms: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2 caused by mutation in AARS

evidence.snippet: Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in (Assessed) — alanyl-tRNA synthetase 1
